description: This is the rightmost plot of Figure 2, which displays the Pearson correlation coefficients between the models’ reported and learned attribute weights for GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, both before and after introspection training. The plot is a single vertical bar chart with two bars, one for each model, positioned side-by-side. The x-axis is labeled “Model” and contains two categories: “GPT-4o” on the left and “GPT-4o-mini” on the right. The y-axis is labeled “Pearson Correlation” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The bar for GPT-4o is colored blue and has a height corresponding to a value of 0.74. The bar for GPT-4o-mini is colored purple and has a height corresponding to a value of 0.75. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model names as listed on the x-axis. There are no error bars or additional visual annotations on the bars themselves.
